description: Push a new version of an artifact behind the same temp.md URL — no re-sharing needed. Resets the 7-day active window. Reads temp_id and update_token from the project's .tempmd file when omitted. If the update fails, the previous version stays live.

additional_files.description: Extra files to publish alongside the main file (scripts, styles, images)

bundle_path.description: Path inside the published bundle, e.g. assets/app.js

source_path.description: Absolute path of the file on disk

file.description: Absolute path to the updated main artifact file

project_dir.description: Project root holding the .tempmd records file. Defaults to the current working directory.

spa_mode.description: Set SPA index fallback explicitly; omitted preserves the current setting

temp_id.description: Temp ID (omit to use the project's .tempmd record)

update_token.description: Update token (omit to use the project's .tempmd record)

name: update_temp
title: Update an existing Temp
